notablePrerequisites:
Ayara does not have summoning sickness.
"Black" chosen with Painter's Servant.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Ayara by tapping it and sacrificing another creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
